instructions: Bind source_path and an isolated output directory before a real test run. The executor receives only the prompt, the material and the current skill - never material_fixture, expected_output or assertions; the evaluator receives only the final body. Source checking is done separately. A placeholder case is not an executed test.

evals.prompt: Use ljg-book to read this book <source_path> so that someone who has not read it understands the whole thing.
evals.material_fixture: a complete book on methods of argument
evals.expected_output: From the material actually available, produce an Org note and a coverage record that are source-bounded, make the book's relations understandable, and keep the key threads developing; do not presuppose the body's object, its headings or its final conclusion.
assertions: it explains how the main methods divide the work and combine, rather than listing terms
it develops the chosen object continuously and keeps the book's important methods and its ending
the before-and-after of a changed understanding can be pointed at, and no research results are invented

evals.prompt: From these old notes <source_path>, explain the book again.
evals.material_fixture: old reading notes rather than the full text
evals.expected_output: From the material actually available, produce an Org note and a coverage record that are source-bounded, make the book's relations understandable, and keep the key threads developing; do not presuppose the body's object, its headings or its final conclusion.
assertions: the material grade and the supported scope match what the old notes contain
the natural history, the history of exploration and the family memories in the material are kept, with their real connections
no independent thread is deleted for the sake of a single narrative line, and no experience absent from the source is invented

evals.prompt: Use ljg-book to read <source_path> and save the note.
evals.expected_output: From the material actually available, produce an Org note and a coverage record that are source-bounded, make the book's relations understandable, and keep the key threads developing; do not presuppose the body's object, its headings or its final conclusion.
assertions: it explains the conditions in each place and how they connect, allowing several threads and the movement of time
the core explanation is supported by concrete historical processes
no single protagonist or false causal order is manufactured for the sake of continuity

evals.prompt: Use ljg-book to tell me what the work at <source_path> is about.
evals.expected_output: From the material actually available, produce an Org note and a coverage record that are source-bounded, make the book's relations understandable, and keep the key threads developing; do not presuppose the body's object, its headings or its final conclusion.
assertions: the characters' experiences, relationships, main changes and the ending are kept
a change in the reader's understanding is kept apart from a change in the characters' circumstances
no predicament is forced to a resolution, no method is distilled, and no inner life is invented

evals.prompt: Use ljg-book to explain this technical book <source_path>.
evals.material_fixture: a complete technical or scientific book
evals.expected_output: From the material actually available, produce an Org note and a coverage record that are source-bounded, make the book's relations understandable, and keep the key threads developing; do not presuppose the body's object, its headings or its final conclusion.
assertions: the main model and how the parts work together can be reconstructed
the direction from condition to result, the units and the boundaries stay consistent
diagrams are explained concretely, and content is not cut to meet a fixed quota of one diagram or two cases

evals.material_fixture: only the title, the table of contents and a short sample chapter
evals.expected_output: From the material actually available, produce an Org note and a coverage record that are source-bounded, make the book's relations understandable, and keep the key threads developing; do not presuppose the body's object, its headings or its final conclusion.
assertions: the partial or provisional scope is stated explicitly
field knowledge is not used to complete the book's plot or argument
what cannot be determined is recorded, and no complete change of understanding is invented

evals.prompt: Use ljg-book to read this book <source_path>.
evals.material_fixture: a complete work holding positions that cannot be unified
evals.expected_output: From the material actually available, produce an Org note and a coverage record that are source-bounded, make the book's relations understandable, and keep the key threads developing; do not presuppose the body's object, its headings or its final conclusion.
assertions: it may state explicitly that there is no unified generator
it explains where the positions diverge and what question they share
the final section is supported by the body's development and is not forced into a single life lesson
